reason: WP 4.2 writes the hall with the v2 glyphs before their meshes exist: the recipes gallery, stairs, dais and brazier arrive with WP 4.4 (engine/gfx/level, the v2 glyphs' meshes), and until then they are drawn as grey blocks with GFX_LEVEL_RECIPE. WP 4.4 removes this entry.

The hall's 8 level meshes (one per recipe, height, surface and footprint, 4 of them the grey blocks above) cost 29 draw calls with one shadow map against the room-sized budget of 20. WP 4.4 draws the v2 recipes (each flight of stairs one mesh) and sets the hall's own number.
